title: Edmund and the Harbor
author: Lior Underhill
blurb: Sable Underhill, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
